title: Dreamforce Agentforce crunch: Dual-Meter stakeholder pressure

moves.dialogueText: "We have 48 hours until Dreamforce keynotes. The CEO wants to demo an autonomous Agentforce agent that issues full refunds directly to customers up to $5,000 without human approval. Can we skip prompt defense testing to hit the demo window?"

options.text: Agree to bypass prompt defense and deploy directly to production sandbox for speed.
options.techDebtImpact: Severe vulnerability: Prompt injection can trigger unlimited fraudulent refund loops.

options.text: Firmly counter with a Well-Architected Guardrail: Enforce a $100 autonomous cap and route >$100 to Human-in-the-Loop Omni-Channel with Trust Layer PII masking active.
options.techDebtImpact: Minimal: Establishes safe boundary pattern while delivering full keynote demo capability.

moves.dialogueText: "Our agent seems slow when fetching customer history. The dev team wants to query the entire 20M Account history table synchronously on every single user turn."

options.text: Allow unindexed synchronous queries on every turn to maximize conversational context.
options.techDebtImpact: Catastrophic: Triggers 10,000ms CPU timeouts and locks user sessions during peak hours.

options.text: Ground the agent via Data Cloud Unified Profile with pre-computed Calculated Insights instead of live SOQL scans.
options.techDebtImpact: Zero: Decouples analytics from core transaction engine with sub-200ms grounding retrieval.

moves.dialogueText: "Our compliance review shows customer Social Security Numbers and credit cards are entering prompt logs in plaintext. We must shut down the agent unless we can guarantee zero retention."

options.text: Activate the Einstein Trust Layer Zero Data Retention and PII Masking policy immediately.
options.techDebtImpact: Resolved: 100% compliance with GDPR/HIPAA with contractual LLM zero data retention.

options.text: Write a custom regex trigger in Apex to scrub plaintext logs after they are saved to disk.
options.techDebtImpact: Regulatory violation: Scrubbing after save still violates zero-retention mandates during inference.
